note: Manual items a person answers during a hardware run. Sources: docs/acceptance-tests/F6.md §Human playtest, D-002 (PocketLoom on the Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G), C9-C12.md §Not proven, packaging.md. Scripts copy them into the report with answer=null until the tester answers.

playtest.ask: Minutes from character select to the open-world exit (first-time player; target 15-20)
HUD, quest log and freeze overlay readable at 1x and 2x scale
Controls work: E interact, H salve (one per press), Tab freeze + 1-4 swap, Q tactic, / typed command
A gamepad drives the menus, Settings and play
Settings: rebinding, colour-blind palette, display style, scanlines, diagnostics toggle (default Off) all work
Music fades and layer changes feel right (explore -> tension -> combat -> boss)
Farm plots, bench, gather nodes and the lair seal are legible
Trash packs feel like fights; did you wipe at the Warden? (how many times)
Quit at a checkpoint and relaunch: the run resumes where you left it
Game-Design sign-off on economy / loot / quest names and numbers (D-005) — notes

android_game.ask: Game Zero launches to the select screen in landscape
Playable with a Bluetooth/USB gamepad (touch controls are not built)
Quit at a checkpoint, swipe the app away, relaunch: the run resumes
Frame pacing feels smooth in the deep cave and the boss fight

android_pocketloom.ask: Generate an asset offline (airplane mode on)
Pair with the desktop: `forge link serve` QR scanned, pairing accepted
Queued jobs drain to the desktop and results sync back
MirrorWeave screen capture (MediaProjection) streams to the desktop
MirrorWeave remote input (AccessibilityService) works after enabling it in system settings
ARCore session + depth start (device supports ARCore)
Note on-device timings shown by PocketLoom (generation ms, sync ms)

web.ask: web (threads) boots and plays in Firefox on the public host
web or web-nothreads boots and plays in Safari (macOS/iOS)
Install as an app (PWA) and play offline after closing the browser
Save, close the tab, reopen: the save is still there
